old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a single lit candle placed on a white ceramic plate with a subtle floral design. The candle is positioned against a rustic wooden background, which adds a warm and natural ambiance to the scene. The flame flickers gently, casting a soft, orange glow that illuminates the immediate surroundings. As the video progresses, the flame remains steady but dynamic, occasionally shifting in size and intensity. The wax of the candle appears slightly melted around the base, indicating it has been burning for some time. The overall atmosphere is serene and intimate, focusing solely on the candle's gentle dance of light and shadow. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, allowing the viewer to fully immerse themselves in the tranquil beauty of the candlelight.

caption: The video captures a lit pale cream taper candle standing slightly tilted in a shallow white oval dish on a wooden surface, set against a vertical wood-paneled wall. A short curled black wick crowns the candle. It supports a single flame that leans steadily to the right and casts an orange glow onto the panel behind it. Throughout the excerpt the flame flickers continuously, cycling between tall, narrow, pointed shapes and shorter, broader, rounded ones, with its tip shifting position from frame to frame. The orange glow on the wood brightens, dims, and drifts slightly in sync with these flickers. The candle body, wick, dish, and background remain essentially fixed, while the camera holds largely steady with only minor handheld jitter. No measurable shortening or deformation of the wax is visible across this segment, and the burning process is already underway at the start and still continuing at the end.
